title: The base change map for the sheaf with exact support is an isomorphism for a flat morphism and a pseudo-coherent closed immersion

difficulty_reason: In the situation of the preceding lemma, assuming f flat and i pseudo-coherent, the lemma asserts that the base change map of equation labelled equation-base-change-exact-support is an isomorphism for K in D^+_QCoh(O_X) (statement lines 2594-2599). The first proof reduces to the affine case with rings A, A', B, B', notes that B and A' are Tor independent over A, and uses Lemma labelled lemma-check-base-change-is-iso to reduce to the equality RHom_A(B, K) otimes^L_A A' = RHom_{A'}(B', K otimes^L_A A') in D(A') for all K in D^+(A); the comparison between derived Hom on rings and on schemes uses Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-internal-hom together with the pseudo-coherence of B over A and of B' over A', and the displayed equality is More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-internal-hom-evaluate-tensor-isomorphism part (3), as discussed in Dualizing Complexes, Section labelled dualizing-section-base-change-trivial-duality (proof lines 2601-2620). The second proof, whose footnote records that it only needs K in D^+(O_X), shows that the map on stalks at a point z' with image z induces the map of Dualizing Complexes, Equation labelled dualizing-equation-base-change, because the two constructions coincide, and then applies Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-flat-bc-surjection (proof lines 2622-2639). Reducing the sheaf statement to the affine algebraic equality, with the ring and scheme derived Homs compared through pseudo-coherence, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
